This website presents interactive disease notification-rate maps by Australian
local government area (LGA).

Select a disease from the panel on the left to open its interactive map. Where
multiple years are available, use the year selector in the upper-right corner
of the map to switch between them.

Use the mouse, trackpad or map controls to zoom and pan. Hover over an LGA to
view its notification rate and other available information.
